narration:1:1421451002:0.text: The woman from centuries ago. Worn down by pain and exhaustion, yet still leading her people here. The first bright spark of the world she carved from the dark.
narration:1:1421451002:0.source_cn: 数百年前，那个忍受着剧痛与疲倦，坚韧不拔地鼓舞着所有人...
